tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and card ground. Paper by day, ink at night. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The one full-bleed contrast band per page (the pilot section). Text on it uses ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body emphasis, the wordmark, primary button fill. 15.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and marks on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, captions, footer text, nav labels at rest. 8.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: muted-inverse
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between ledger rows and inside lists. Never a box border around content.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: The heavier rule that opens and closes a section (header bottom, services top and bottom, footer top).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: One word in italic in a headline, links, the numerals in a step list, button hover. Text-safe on surface in both themes (8.6:1 light, 9.2:1 dark). One accent per screen.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The dot in the mark and nothing else in the UI. Not text-safe on surface (2.0:1 on paper); it lives only inside the logo and on ink grounds as a graphic.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only. One italic word in accent allowed. Clamp to 38px on small screens. Libre Baskerville is a wide face: keep headlines to two or three lines.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: The first few are for the references.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section title that sits on a rule-strong line.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The brand name in the header, always beside the mark.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Hero lede, max 600px measure, in muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A form on your site becomes a contact, a conflict check, an open matter.
styles.usage: Default paragraph. 17px is the floor for running text on the web.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The lead phrase of a step or list item, in ink.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Nav links, button labels, section sub-notes.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Typical fit: estate planning, family law.
styles.usage: The third column of a ledger row, footer meta. Always muted.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a display-lg statement. Uppercase is applied in CSS, not in copy.

spacing.note: An 8px scale with a 4px half step. Sections breathe at 80-120px; rows at 28px; inline gaps at 12-24px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets, underline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between the mark and the wordmark; icon-to-text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing, list item gap on small screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Step number to step text; caption column inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Column gap in the ledger grid; CTA row gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a ledger row and the header.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Headline to lede; lede to CTA row.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Two-column gap on narrow layouts; grid gap in galleries.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Two-column gap on wide layouts; section padding minimum.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (56px on mobile, scaled with clamp).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a lede or paragraph.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Content column width; the page is min(1120px, 100% - 48px).

radius.note: Two shapes only: square edges for everything editorial, full pills for anything you press.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Rows, sections, rules, images, tables. The default.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Only for the 240px avatar tile when the mark is shown on a colored ground in a gallery.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and nav pills. Height 44px in the header, 52px as a hero CTA, 50px on inverse bands.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule between rows uses 1px of rule or rule-strong.

tokens.name: outline-button
tokens.usage: Stroke of the outlined pill button, in ink.
